name: False Step Floor
disable: DC 28 Thievery check (trained) to disrupt the magical energy, or DC 27 Arcana check or DC 27 Occultism check (trained) to realign the magical energy

items.name: False Step
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the room and steps onto the floor

Effect The creature slips through the floor; it tumbles through an interdimensional void before falling back into the room through the ceiling and landing on the floor. The triggering creature takes 40 bludgeoning damage from the fall. That creature can try to grab-an-edge dc=24 to avoid falling.

text: Each time a creature enters the room, it slips through the floor, tumbles through an interdimensional void, and falls back into the room through the ceiling, landing on the floor.
